      ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

      ☁️ How is data synced? ▼
      MFFocus automatically syncs your focus sessions, gold coins, and settings to the cloud in real-time.
      🥇 How to earn & spend Gold? ▼
      You earn 1 Gold for every 30 minutes of focus time. Redeem gold in the Distraction Shop or earn +1 Gold by reporting bugs!
      🐛 How does the Bug Reward work? ▼
      Select "🐛 Bug Report" category, write the bug details, and send. +1 Gold is credited automatically upon submission (once per 24h).
      👥 How do Secret Groups work? ▼
      Join or create a group with a custom access code to compare study times and chat with group members.

      📌 DISPLAY NAME

      The public name shown prominently around MFFocus. Does NOT need to be unique. Spaces, numbers, and capitalization allowed (max 35 chars).

      Globally unique account handle (3–20 chars: letters, numbers, underscores). Case-insensitive. Used to distinguish accounts with identical display names.
